# Enigma UI: guide for AI assistants (full)

Enigma UI is the Enigma Technology Lab design system: plain CSS tokens and component styles (`@enigma-ui/css`), with Angular (`@enigma-ui/angular`) and React (`@enigma-ui/react`) components on top. Accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA, text at 7:1), light and dark, left-to-right and right-to-left (Arabic first-class). 44 components.

Site and live demos: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/
Pick one framework section below and ignore the others.

## Rules for AI assistants

Follow these every time you write code with Enigma UI.

1. Use the kit's components and classes. Do not hand-build a button, field, dialog or table that the kit already has.
2. Restyle only through the `--ui-*` tokens and Tailwind classes. Never override a `.ui-*` class, and never copy the kit's CSS into the project.
3. Never invent props, classes or components. If a name is not in this guide, it does not exist: check the component's page on the docs site.
4. Use colour tokens, never raw hex values: `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`, `var(--ui-primary)`. Colours switch with the theme (`data-theme="light"` or `"dark"`, or the system setting).
5. Space comes from the scale: `p-4`, `gap-3`, `ui-p-4` (without Tailwind). Do not write pixel values.
6. Use logical properties (`ms-2`, `pe-4`, `start`, `end`), never `left` or `right`, so the layout flips in right-to-left languages.
7. Always set `lang` and `dir` on `<html>`. In an Arabic app translate every label a component shows (close buttons, toast region, pagination).
8. Every control needs a visible label. Colour never carries meaning alone: an error also has text.
9. Put your own CSS in `@layer components` or `@layer base`, or a plain rule beats the kit's classes.
10. Open native dialogs with `showModal()`, never `show()`.
11. Angular: components are standalone, import each one in `imports`. Use signals and the new control flow (`@if`, `@for`). React: React 19, function components.
12. When unsure, say so and point to the docs page instead of guessing.

## Tokens

All design values are `--ui-*` custom properties on `:root`. With Tailwind they are the theme: `p-4` is `--ui-space-4`, `bg-primary` is `--ui-primary`, `rounded-xl` is `--ui-radius-xl`.

- Colour: `--ui-surface`, `--ui-border`, `--ui-primary`, `--ui-on-primary`, `--ui-focus`, `--ui-highlight`, `--ui-danger`, `--ui-danger-soft`, `--ui-focus-width`, `--ui-focus-offset`. Full list on https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/foundations/colour
- Space: `--ui-space-1` to `--ui-space-*`, as classes `ui-p-*`, `ui-m-*`, `ui-gap-*` (sides `x y t b s e`, logical).
- Type: one class sets face, weight, size and line height: `ui-head-3xl` … `ui-head-2xs`, `ui-body-lg|md|sm` (weight suffix `-m` `-s` `-b`), `ui-label`.
- Layout: `class="ui-page"` gives a centred 12-column grid; children take `ui-col-6`, `ui-col-md-4` (`sm md lg xl 2xl`).
- Also: radius, shadow (`shadow-ui`), z-index (`z-dialog`), motion (`duration-fast`, `ease-ui`), focus (`focus-visible:focus-ring`).

Re-brand by overriding tokens after the import. The "on" colour must reach 7:1 against its ground and the focus colour 3:1 against the page, in both themes:

```css
:root {
  --ui-primary: light-dark(#0f5132, #6ee7b7);
  --ui-on-primary: light-dark(#ffffff, #0b1020);
  --ui-focus: light-dark(#0f5132, #6ee7b7);
}
```

# Angular

## Setup (Angular)

```sh
pnpm add @enigma-ui/angular @enigma-ui/css @angular/cdk@^22.2.0
pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
```

Needs Node 22, Angular 22.2 (core, common, forms, router), the same major of the Angular CDK, RxJS 7.8, Tailwind 4.1.

```json
// .postcssrc.json, next to angular.json
{ "plugins": { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} } }
```

```css
/* the global stylesheet (src/styles.css), first lines; never in a component's styles */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@enigma-ui/css/tailwind.css';
@import '@angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css';
@import '@angular/cdk/a11y-prebuilt.css';
```

UiDialog, UiAlertDialog and UiToast are provided in root: inject them where needed.

## Components (Angular)

### Accordion

A stack of sections that open and close, such as questions and answers. Built on the native details element, so it opens with Enter and Space, works without script, and the browser's find-in-page opens the section that holds the match. Sections grow and shrink smoothly both ways, Up and Down move between the headings, and the chevron mirrors in Arabic.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/accordion

```ts
import {
  AccordionComponent,
  AccordionContentDirective,
  AccordionItemComponent,
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Each item is a native <details ui-accordion-item>.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `single` | `boolean` | `false` | On ui-accordion: one section open at a time. |
| `icon` | `'end' \| 'start' \| 'none'` | `'end'` | On ui-accordion, or one item: where the chevron sits. At the start it points to where the text reads on. |
| `heading` | `string` |  | On each item: the text that opens it. For richer content, an element with uiAccordionHeading. |
| `description` | `string` |  | On each item: a quieter line under the heading. |
| `open, [(open)]` | `boolean` | `false` | On each item: open or not. Closing runs its motion. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | On each item: focusable and announced, but it does not open. |
| `ng-template uiAccordionContent` | `directive` |  | Inside an item: content created when it opens. |
| `keep` | `boolean` | `false` | On each item: keeps lazy content once shown. Off, it goes once closed and loads again on the next open. |

### Alert dialog

A short message that needs an answer before the reader goes on: confirm a delete, keep or discard changes. Only its buttons answer: Escape and a click outside do nothing, because the reader has to choose. Focus starts on the safest button.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert-dialog

```ts
import { UiAlertDialog } from '@enigma-ui/angular';

private readonly alerts = inject(UiAlertDialog);
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alert(options)` | `Promise<R \| undefined>` |  | The value of the pressed action. |
| `confirm(options)` | `Promise<boolean>` |  | true only when the confirm button is pressed. |
| `options.title / message` | `string` |  | Required. The question, and what happens. Plain text, never HTML. |
| `options.tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` |  | Shown as an icon; say it in the title too. |
| `options.actions` | `{ label, value, variant?, initialFocus? }[]` |  | One to three buttons. Focus starts on the marked one, else the first that is not danger. |
| `confirm: confirmLabel / cancelLabel` | `string` | `cancel: 'Cancel'` | The translated button texts. |
| `confirm: danger` | `boolean` | `false` | Danger tone and button, and focus starts on Cancel. |

### Alert

A message in the page, such as a problem with the whole form or a notice about the account. The title says what it is in words; the icon's shape and the colour repeat it. For a note after an action, use a toast; for a question that needs an answer, an alert dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert

```ts
import { AlertComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Not announced on page load. Shown after an action? Add role="alert" or role="status".
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Icon and colour. The title must say it too. |
| `title` | `string` |  | A few words in bold that say what it is. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a close button. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Its accessible name, translated. |
| `(dismiss)` | `void` |  | The close button was pressed: remove the alert. |
| `[ui-alert-actions]` | `slot` |  | An element holding buttons, under the message. |

### Avatar

A person's photo, or their initials when there is no photo or it fails to load. Screen readers hear the person's name, never the file name.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/avatar

```ts
import { AvatarComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  | Required. Read by screen readers and turned into the initials. |
| `src` | `string` |  | The photo. Initials show while it is missing or broken. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 32, 40 or 56 pixels. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides it from screen readers, for when the name is on screen next to it. |

### Badge

A short status label, such as the state of an order. The words carry the meaning and the colour only repeats it, so every status reads the same without colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/badge

```ts
import { BadgeComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` | The colour. The text must say the status too. |

### Bottom sheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen, for a short choice or the details of an item, mostly on phones. It is a dialog docked to the bottom: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click above it closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/bottom-sheet

```ts
import {
  DialogCloseDirective,
  DialogComponent,
  UiDialog,
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<ui-dialog> variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer' \| 'sheet'` | `'default'` | 'sheet': docked to the bottom. Open it with UiDialog.open() as any dialog. |
| `<ui-dialog> size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Its width on a wide screen: 24, 32 or 48rem. The full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | title, description, closeLabel, [ui-dialog-actions], uiDialogClose and the open() config work as in the dialog. |

### Breadcrumbs

Where the page sits, as a trail of links back up. A named navigation landmark around an ordered list; the last item is the page itself, marked as current and not a link. The slashes are drawn, not read out.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/breadcrumbs

```ts
import { BreadcrumbsComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Put each link in an <li>. Works with routerLink or href.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Breadcrumb'` | Names the landmark, translated. |
| `<li> children` | `content` |  | One per step; the last holds aria-current="page". |

### Button

Styles the native button, so it keeps everything the browser gives a button: focus, Enter and Space, form submit. Four variants and three sizes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/button

```ts
import { ButtonComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | How much the button stands out. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Padding and text size. Height never drops under 44 pixels. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button, sets aria-busy and shows a spinner. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button. |

### Calendar

A month grid to pick a day or a range, such as a delivery day or a stay. One Tab stop: arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End go to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down change the month, with Shift the year. Each day is read in full, Thursday, 19 November 2026. Today is underlined and picked days are filled, so neither depends on colour. Use it when seeing the month helps: open and closed days, a range, or the weekday. For a date people already know, such as a birthday, use the date field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/calendar

```ts
import { CalendarComponent, type DateRange } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD), the same as <input type="date">.
```

### Card

A surface that groups related content: a summary, a list, a form. Cards are flat, with a thin border; shadows are kept for things that float, like menus and dialogs.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/card

```ts
import { CardComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Optional heading at the top of the card. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | The heading level of the title. |
| `padding` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 1.5rem or 2rem inside the border. |

### Checkbox

A yes or no that is saved with the form, such as accepting the terms. The native checkbox in the primary colour; the whole label is the hit area, at least 44px tall.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/checkbox

```ts
import { CheckboxComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is true or false. Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label; the whole label is the hit area. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the checkbox, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the checkbox invalid and announces the message. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a dash: some of the items under it are ticked. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |

### Chip input

A text field that collects several short values, such as toppings, email addresses or skills. Each value becomes a tag with its own named remove button. Screen readers hear each value being added and removed, and focus never falls off the field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/chip-input

```ts
import { ChipInputComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is a string[]. Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

### Combobox

A text field that filters a list as you type, for a long list such as countries. Focus stays in the field: arrow keys move through the matches, Enter picks one and Escape closes the list. The value is always one of the options.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/combobox

```ts
import { ComboboxComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Options are { value, label, disabled? }, as for ui-select. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the field and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? }. The label is what is matched. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Shown while the field is empty. |
| `hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `emptyText` | `string` | `'No matches'` | Announced when nothing matches; pass the translated text. |
| `compareWith` | `(a: T, b: T) => boolean` | `===` | How to match the form value to an option, for object values. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input; options get -option-<index>. |

### Command palette

A search over the app's actions, in a dialog. Ctrl+K or ⌘K opens it from anywhere; typing filters, the arrow keys move and Enter runs. Screen readers hear how many commands match as you type. Keep a visible button for it too: a shortcut nobody knows about is no way in.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/command-palette

```ts
import { CommandPaletteComponent, type Command } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Built on the kit's dialog. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

### Data table

Rows of records the reader scans and compares: orders, users, payments. A real table, named by its caption, so screen readers announce the row and column of every cell. Sorting is announced too.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/data-table

```ts
import {
  DataTableComponent,
  TableCellDirective,
  type TableColumn,
  type TableSort,
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | `string` |  | Required. Names the table; screen readers announce it. |
| `hideCaption` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the caption for screen readers only, when a heading above already names the table. |
| `columns` | `TableColumn<T>[]` |  | Required. { key, header, sortable?, align?, value? } per column. |
| `rows` | `T[]` |  | Required. The rows of the current page. |
| `sort` | `TableSort \| null (model)` |  | Bind [(sort)]: { key, direction }. Sort the rows yourself. |
| `rowKey` | `keyof T \| (row) => unknown` |  | What identifies a row, so rows keep their state across updates. |
| `loading / loadingLabel` | `boolean / string` | `false / 'Loading'` | Marks the table busy and reads the label once. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `'No results'` | Shown when there are no rows; pass the translated text. |
| `ng-template uiCell="key"` | `directive` |  | A custom cell for that column; let-row gives the row. |

### Date and number fields

The text field with the browser's own date, time and number inputs. The picker comes in the reader's language and calendar, works with the keyboard and screen readers, and opens the right keypad on a phone. The value stays a plain ISO date, such as 2026-12-01.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/date-field

```ts
import { TextFieldComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// ui-text-field with type="date", "time", "datetime-local" or "number".
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime-local' \| 'number'` |  | On ui-text-field. Every other text field input works too. |
| `min, max` | `string \| number` |  | The range: '2026-01-31' for a date, '09:00' for a time, 1 for a number. |
| `step` | `string \| number` |  | The steps: seconds for a time, units for a number. |

### Dialog

A modal window for a task that needs the reader's full attention: a short form, details, terms. Focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/dialog

```ts
import {
  DialogCloseDirective,
  DialogComponent,
  UiDialog,
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `UiDialog.open(content, config?)` | `DialogRef<R>` |  | Opens a component or a template. closed emits the result once. |
| `config.data` | `D` |  | Read it with inject(DIALOG_DATA) in a component, or let-data in a template. |
| `config.dismissable` | `boolean` | `true` | false: only your own buttons close it. Escape and a click outside do nothing, and the close button is hidden. |
| `config.initialFocus` | `CSS selector` | `the heading` | The element to focus first. |
| `<ui-dialog> title` | `string` |  | Required. The heading; it names the dialog. |
| `<ui-dialog> description` | `string` |  | A sentence under the title, read with it. |
| `<ui-dialog> size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide, never wider than the screen. |
| `<ui-dialog> closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close'` | Accessible name of the close button; pass the translated text. |
| `[ui-dialog-actions]` | `content slot` |  | The buttons; they line up at the end and stay in view. |
| `uiDialogClose` | `directive` |  | On a button: closes the dialog with its value, or none when bare. |

### Divider

A thin line between groups of content. Reach for space first: a divider is for when space alone does not show where one group ends.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/divider

```ts
import { DividerComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which way the line runs. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Words in the middle of the line, read as text. Horizontal only. |

### Drawer

A side panel that slides in from the edge, for a form or the details of a row, while the list stays in sight. It is a dialog docked to the side: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, only the body scrolls, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/drawer

```ts
import {
  DialogCloseDirective,
  DialogComponent,
  UiDialog,
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<ui-dialog> variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer'` | `'default'` | 'drawer': full height on the inline end. Open it with UiDialog.open() as any dialog. |
| `<ui-dialog> size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide; the full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | title, description, closeLabel, [ui-dialog-actions], uiDialogClose and the open() config work as in the dialog. |

### Empty state

What a list, table or page shows while it has nothing in it. It says what will appear here, why it is empty now, and offers the one action that fills it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/empty-state

```ts
import { EmptyStateComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Required. What is missing, as a heading. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title, so it fits the page outline. |
| `[ui-empty-state-actions]` | `slot` |  | The action that fills the space. One, usually. |

### Fieldset

A titled group of fields inside a longer form. Screen readers read the legend as they enter the group, so a field called Street is heard as part of the delivery address.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/fieldset

```ts
import { FieldsetComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// An attribute on a native fieldset: <fieldset ui-fieldset legend="…">
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legend` | `string` |  | Required. The group title. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | A line under the legend, read with the group. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | The native attribute: disables every field inside. |

### File field

The browser's own file input, with a label, hint and error, in a zone that also takes files dropped on it. The native button and file names stay, so it works with the keyboard, screen readers and phone cameras as usual.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/file-field

```ts
import { FileFieldComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is a File[]. Writing null or [] to the control clears the input.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the input. |
| `accept` | `string` |  | File types the picker offers: '.pdf', 'image/*'. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows more than one file. |
| `hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `dropText` | `string` | `'Or drop a file here'` | The line under the button; pass the translated text. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |

### Language switcher

Switches the interface language. Each language is named in itself, so someone who reads only that language can find it, and carries its lang, so screen readers say it in the right voice. No flags: a flag is a country, not a language. Set lang and dir on the html element when the language changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/language-switcher

```ts
import { LanguageSwitcherComponent, type Language } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Three or more languages use the Angular CDK menu. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `languages` | `Language[]` |  | Required. { code, name }, each name in its own language. |
| `[(current)]` | `string` |  | Required. The current language's code. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Language'` | Three or more: read before the current name on the button, and the menu’s name. Translate it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | The button's size. |

### Menu

A short list of actions that opens from a button, such as the actions on a row. Enter, Space or the down arrow open it, the arrow keys and typing move through it, and Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button. For choosing a value, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/menu

```ts
import { MenuComponent, MenuItemComponent, MenuTriggerDirective } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK menu. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[uiMenuTrigger]` | `TemplateRef` |  | On the button; the template holding the ui-menu. |
| `ui-menu` | `component` |  | The list, inside that template. |
| `button[ui-menu-item]` | `component` |  | One action. |
| `(triggered)` | `void` |  | The action was chosen by click, Enter or Space. |
| `danger` | `boolean` | `false` | Red text, for an action that destroys something. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Shown, but cannot be chosen. |

### Navigation

The app's main links, in a side bar. A named navigation landmark, links at least 44px tall, and the current page marked with a bar and bold text, not only a fill. On a phone, put the same links in a drawer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/nav

```ts
import { NavComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Mark the current link with routerLinkActive ariaCurrentWhenActive="page".
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the landmark, so it differs from other navigation. |
| `content` | `ul, h2` |  | Lists of links, with optional group titles. |

### Pagination

Moves through long lists a page at a time. A named navigation landmark: each page button says its number, the current page is marked, and the line of shown rows is announced when it changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/pagination

```ts
import { PaginationComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `number (model)` |  | Required. The current page, from 1. Bind [(page)]. |
| `total` | `number` |  | Required. Rows across all pages. |
| `pageSize` | `number (model)` | `10` | Rows per page. Bind [(pageSize)] with a picker. |
| `pageSizes` | `number[]` | `[]` | Offer these sizes in a picker. Empty: no picker. |
| `labels` | `Partial<PaginationLabels>` |  | Translated texts: nav, previous, next, page(n), summary(first, last, total), pageSize. |

### Popover

A small panel next to its button, for a few details or a couple of settings. It is not modal: focus moves into it, and Escape or a click outside closes it and puts focus back on the button. Screen readers name it after the button. For a task that needs the reader's full attention, use a dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/popover

```ts
import { PopoverTriggerDirective } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK overlay. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[uiPopoverTrigger]` | `TemplateRef` |  | Required, on the button: the content to show. |

### Progress

How far a long task has got, such as an upload. The native progress bar, named by its label, with the amount in words beside it. Without a value it shows a moving band: work is going on but its length is not known.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/progress

```ts
import { ProgressComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the bar. |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | How much is done. Leave it out when unknown. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | The value when done. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | The amount in words; defaults to a percentage. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the progress element. |

### Radio group

One choice from a short list, with every option in view. Native radios: Tab reaches the group, arrow keys move the choice. For more than five or six options, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/radio-group

```ts
import { RadioGroupComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Options are { value, label, disabled? }, as for ui-select.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the group. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? } for each radio. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Side by side for two or three short answers. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the label, read with the group. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the group invalid and announces the message. |
| `compareWith` | `(a: T, b: T) => boolean` | `===` | How to match the form value to an option, for object values. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid prefix; each radio gets -<index>. |

### Rating

Stars out of five, to pick a score or to show one. Picking uses real radio buttons, so Tab reaches the stars, arrow keys move between them and a screen reader says 3 stars, 3 of 5. Filled stars are solid and empty ones an outline, so the shape tells them apart, not only colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/rating

```ts
import { RatingComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is a number, or null before a pick. Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

### Select

One choice from a list. Arrow keys, Home and End, and typing the first letters all move through the options; Escape and Tab close the list and return focus.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/select

```ts
import { SelectComponent, type SelectOption } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label; it names the button and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? } for each option. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the select invalid and announces the message. |
| `compareWith` | `(a: T, b: T) => boolean` | `===` | How to match the form value to an option, for object values. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the button; options get -option-<index>. |

### Skeleton

Grey shapes where content is loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Screen readers skip the shapes: mark the area busy and say it is loading with a spinner or a status message. With reduced motion the shapes stop pulsing.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/skeleton

```ts
import { SkeletonComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'circle' \| 'block'` | `'text'` | Lines, an avatar, or an image or card. |
| `lines` | `number` | `1` | Lines of text; the last one is shorter. |

### Slider

A value picked along a range, such as a price limit or a volume. It is the browser's own range input, so arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End all move it, and the value is written beside the label. For an exact number, use a number field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/slider

```ts
import { SliderComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is a number. Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

### Spinner

Shows that something is loading and says what, in words, to screen readers. Keep it for waits of more than a second. With reduced motion it stops turning and stays as a faint ring.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/spinner

```ts
import { SpinnerComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading'` | What is loading, translated; read by screen readers. |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label next to it too. |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | lg: a big spinner over its label, for a page or panel. |

### Stat

One number with its label, and how it changed. The change is written out, with its sign or in words; the arrow and the colour only repeat it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stat

```ts
import { StatComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

### Stepper

A flow split into steps, such as checkout. Each step holds its own content, and the stepper shows the current one with Back and Next under it. The step names are buttons, so people can go back. Done steps have a tick and are read as Done, the current one is announced as the current step, and focus moves to the new step's content after each change.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stepper

```ts
import { StepComponent, StepperComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

### Switch

An on or off setting that takes effect at once, with no save button. Screen readers say on and off, and the knob's side shows the state, so it never depends on colour. For a choice saved with a form, use a checkbox.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/switch

```ts
import { SwitchComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// The value is true or false. Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The setting it turns on. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under it, read with the switch. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |

### Tabs

Views of one thing side by side, such as an order's details and its history. Tab reaches the chosen tab, the arrow keys move between tabs and show each one, Home and End go to the first and last. The chosen tab gets a bar and full-strength text, not only a colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tabs

```ts
import {
  TabComponent,
  TabContentDirective, // content created only when its tab is shown
  TabNavComponent, // tabs that are pages, with the router
  TabsComponent,
  KeepRouteStrategy, // keeps a routed tab's page between visits
} from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required, on ui-tabs. Names the tab list. |
| `[(selected)]` | `number` | `0` | The index of the chosen tab. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid prefix; each tab gets -<index>. |
| `ui-tab label` | `string` |  | Required. The text on the tab. |
| `ui-tab disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Shown but not chosen; arrow keys skip it. |
| `ui-tab keep` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps uiTabContent once shown, hidden while another tab is chosen. Off, it is made again on each visit. |
| `ng-template uiTabContent` | `directive` |  | Inside ui-tab. The tab's content, created only when the tab is chosen. |
| `ui-tab-nav label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the navigation; put links with class="ui-tab" inside. |
| `KeepRouteStrategy` | `RouteReuseStrategy` |  | Provide it as the RouteReuseStrategy; a route with data: { keep: true } keeps its page between tabs, until the reader leaves the section. |

### Tag

A label the user added or can take away, such as an active filter or a topic. For a status like Paid or Late, use a badge.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tag

```ts
import { TagComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `removable` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the × button. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | `'Remove'` | The button's first word; the tag's text follows it. Translate it. |
| `(remove)` | `void` |  | The × was pressed. Remove the tag and move focus on. |

### Text field

Label, input, hint and error as one control. The label, hint and error are tied to the input, so screen readers read all three.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/text-field

```ts
import { TextFieldComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the input. |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'search' \| 'tel' \| 'url'` | `'text'` | The input type. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the input, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the input invalid and announces the message. |
| `autocomplete` | `string` |  | The browser autofill hint, such as email or name. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |

### Textarea

The multi-line twin of the text field: the same label, hint and error, with room for a few lines. The reader can make it taller.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/textarea

```ts
import { TextareaComponent } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the textarea. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Height in lines. The reader can still make it taller. |
| `maxlength` | `number` |  | The most characters it accepts. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the textarea, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the textarea invalid and announces the message. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the textarea, for tests. |

### Toast

A short note after an action, such as Saved, at the bottom end of the screen. Screen readers hear it as it comes. It closes by itself after 6 seconds, but never while the pointer or focus is on it, and never when it holds an action, so nobody loses the Undo to a timer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/toast

```ts
import { UiToast } from '@enigma-ui/angular';

const toast = inject(UiToast);
toast.labels.set({ region: 'Notifications', close: 'Dismiss' }); // translated, once
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show(message, options?)` | `number` |  | Shows a toast and returns its id. |
| `options.tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Icon and colour. Danger is announced at once. |
| `options.title` | `string` |  | A few words in bold before the message. |
| `options.duration` | `number` | `6000` | Milliseconds; 0 keeps it. With an action it defaults to 0. |
| `options.action` | `{ label, run }` |  | One button; pressing it closes the toast. |
| `dismiss(id)` | `void` |  | Closes a toast. |
| `labels` | `signal` | `{ region: 'Notifications', close: 'Dismiss' }` | The region name and close button name, translated. |

### Tooltip

A short label for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus and read by screen readers as its description. The pointer can move onto it and Escape hides it. Touch screens never show tooltips, so never put anything needed in one.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tooltip

```ts
import { TooltipDirective } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK overlay. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uiTooltip` | `string` |  | Required. The short label, on any focusable element. |

### Tree

Nested items that open and close, such as folders or menu categories. One Tab stop: the arrow keys move, Right opens a branch and Left closes it, typing a name jumps to it, and Enter or Space selects. For a site's page links, use navigation instead.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tree

```ts
import { TreeComponent, type TreeNode } from '@enigma-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK tree.
```


# React

## Setup (React)

```sh
pnpm add @enigma-ui/react @enigma-ui/css
pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
```

Needs Node 22, React 19, Tailwind 4.1.

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()] });
```

```css
/* src/index.css, imported once in main.tsx, above every other CSS import */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@enigma-ui/css/tailwind.css';
```

Wrap the app in `ToastProvider` if you use toasts (`useToast()` throws without it). For Arabic also wrap it in React Aria's `I18nProvider locale="ar"`.

## Components (React)

### Accordion

A stack of sections that open and close, such as questions and answers. Built on the native details element, so it opens with Enter and Space, works without script, and the browser's find-in-page opens the section that holds the match. Sections grow and shrink smoothly both ways, Up and Down move between the headings, and the chevron mirrors in Arabic.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/accordion

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `single` | `boolean` | `false` | On Accordion: one section open at a time. |
| `icon` | `'end' \| 'start' \| 'none'` | `'end'` | On Accordion, or one AccordionItem: where the chevron sits. |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` |  | Required, on AccordionItem: what opens it. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | On AccordionItem: a quieter line under the heading. |
| `open, defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  | On AccordionItem: controlled, or open at first. Closing runs its motion. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: focusable and announced, but it does not open. |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: mounts the children when it opens. |
| `keep` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: keeps lazy children once mounted. Off, they unmount once closed. |
| `...props` | `details props` |  | On AccordionItem: onToggle and the rest. |

### Alert dialog

A short message that needs an answer before the reader goes on: confirm a delete, keep or discard changes. Only its buttons answer: Escape and a click outside do nothing, because the reader has to choose. Focus starts on the safest button.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert-dialog

```tsx
import { useAlertDialog } from '@enigma-ui/react';

const { alert, confirm, dialog } = useAlertDialog();
// render {dialog} once in the component, then await alert() or confirm()
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `useAlertDialog()` | `{ alert, confirm, dialog }` |  | Render dialog once; alert() and confirm() return promises. |
| `alert(options)` | `Promise<R \| undefined>` |  | The value of the pressed action. |
| `confirm(options)` | `Promise<boolean>` |  | true only when the confirm button is pressed. |
| `options` | `as in Angular` |  | title, message, tone and actions; confirmLabel, cancelLabel and danger for confirm. |
| `<AlertDialog>` | `component` |  | The same dialog, controlled: open, the options, and onAction(value). |

### Alert

A message in the page, such as a problem with the whole form or a notice about the account. The title says what it is in words; the icon's shape and the colour repeat it. For a note after an action, use a toast; for a question that needs an answer, an alert dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Icon and colour. The title must say it too. |
| `title` | `string` |  | A few words in bold that say what it is. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons under the message. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Shows a close button that calls it. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Its accessible name, translated. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop, such as role. |

### Avatar

A person's photo, or their initials when there is no photo or it fails to load. Screen readers hear the person's name, never the file name.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/avatar

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  | Required. Read by screen readers and turned into the initials. |
| `src` | `string` |  | The photo. Initials show while it is missing or broken. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 32, 40 or 56 pixels. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides it from screen readers, for when the name is on screen next to it. |

### Badge

A short status label, such as the state of an order. The words carry the meaning and the colour only repeats it, so every status reads the same without colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/badge

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` | The colour. The text must say the status too. |
| `...props` | `span props` |  | Every native span prop: id, title, ref. |

### Bottom sheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen, for a short choice or the details of an item, mostly on phones. It is a dialog docked to the bottom: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click above it closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/bottom-sheet

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer' \| 'sheet'` | `'default'` | 'sheet': docked to the bottom. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Its width on a wide screen: 24, 32 or 48rem. The full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | title, description, open, onOpenChange, actions, dismissable and closeLabel work as in the dialog. |

### Breadcrumbs

Where the page sits, as a trail of links back up. A named navigation landmark around an ordered list; the last item is the page itself, marked as current and not a link. The slashes are drawn, not read out.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/breadcrumbs

```tsx
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Breadcrumb'` | Names the landmark, translated. |
| `children` | `<li> elements` |  | One per step; the last holds aria-current="page". |

### Button

Styles the native button, so it keeps everything the browser gives a button: focus, Enter and Space, form submit. Four variants and three sizes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/button

```tsx
import { Button } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | How much the button stands out. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Padding and text size. Height never drops under 44 pixels. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button, sets aria-busy and shows a spinner. |
| `...props` | `button props` |  | Every native button prop: type, onClick, disabled, form, ref. |

### Calendar

A month grid to pick a day or a range, such as a delivery day or a stay. One Tab stop: arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End go to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down change the month, with Shift the year. Each day is read in full, Thursday, 19 November 2026. Today is underlined and picked days are filled, so neither depends on colour. Use it when seeing the month helps: open and closed days, a range, or the weekday. For a date people already know, such as a birthday, use the date field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/calendar

```tsx
import { Calendar, RangeCalendar, type DateRange } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD). Language follows the nearest I18nProvider from react-aria-components.
```

### Card

A surface that groups related content: a summary, a list, a form. Cards are flat, with a thin border; shadows are kept for things that float, like menus and dialogs.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/card

```tsx
import { Card } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Optional heading at the top of the card. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | The heading level of the title. |
| `padding` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 1.5rem or 2rem inside the border. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop: id, aria-label, ref. |

### Checkbox

A yes or no that is saved with the form, such as accepting the terms. The native checkbox in the primary colour; the whole label is the hit area, at least 44px tall.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/checkbox

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: checked, onChange, name, ref.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text, read with the checkbox. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks it invalid and announces the message. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a dash: some of the items under it are ticked. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: checked, defaultChecked, onChange, name, ref. |

### Chip input

A text field that collects several short values, such as toppings, email addresses or skills. Each value becomes a tag with its own named remove button. Screen readers hear each value being added and removed, and focus never falls off the field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/chip-input

```tsx
import { ChipInput } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

### Combobox

A text field that filters a list as you type, for a long list such as countries. Focus stays in the field: arrow keys move through the matches, Enter picks one and Escape closes the list. The value is always one of the options.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/combobox

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the field and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? }. |
| `value, defaultValue` | `T \| null` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T \| null) => void` |  | Called with the picked value, or null when the field is emptied. |
| `placeholder, hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `emptyText` | `string` | `'No matches'` | Announced when nothing matches. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the field. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Sends the value with a native form. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input; options get -option-<index>. |

### Command palette

A search over the app's actions, in a dialog. Ctrl+K or ⌘K opens it from anywhere; typing filters, the arrow keys move and Enter runs. Screen readers hear how many commands match as you type. Keep a visible button for it too: a shortcut nobody knows about is no way in.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/command-palette

```tsx
import { CommandPalette, type Command } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

### Data table

Rows of records the reader scans and compares: orders, users, payments. A real table, named by its caption, so screen readers announce the row and column of every cell. Sorting is announced too.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/data-table

```tsx
import { DataTable, type TableColumn, type TableSort } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | `string` |  | Required. Names the table; screen readers announce it. |
| `hideCaption` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the caption for screen readers only. |
| `columns` | `TableColumn<T>[]` |  | Required. { key, header, sortable?, align?, value?, cell? } per column. |
| `rows` | `T[]` |  | Required. The rows of the current page. |
| `sort / onSortChange` | `TableSort \| null / (sort) => void` |  | The sort state, controlled. Sort the rows yourself. |
| `rowKey` | `keyof T \| (row) => Key` |  | Used as the React key of each row. |
| `loading / loadingLabel` | `boolean / string` | `false / 'Loading'` | Marks the table busy and reads the label once. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `'No results'` | Shown when there are no rows; pass the translated text. |

### Date and number fields

The text field with the browser's own date, time and number inputs. The picker comes in the reader's language and calendar, works with the keyboard and screen readers, and opens the right keypad on a phone. The value stays a plain ISO date, such as 2026-12-01.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/date-field

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// TextField with type="date", "time", "datetime-local" or "number".
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime-local' \| 'number'` |  | On TextField. min, max and step pass to the input. |

### Dialog

A modal window for a task that needs the reader's full attention: a short form, details, terms. Focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/dialog

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Required. The heading; it names the dialog. |
| `open / onOpenChange` | `boolean / (open) => void` |  | Required. onOpenChange(false) comes from Escape, the backdrop or the close button. |
| `description` | `string` |  | A sentence under the title, read with it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide, never wider than the screen. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | The buttons; they line up at the end and stay in view. |
| `dismissable` | `boolean` | `true` | false: only your own buttons close it. Escape and a click outside do nothing, and the close button is hidden. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close'` | Accessible name of the close button; pass the translated text. |

### Divider

A thin line between groups of content. Reach for space first: a divider is for when space alone does not show where one group ends.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/divider

```tsx
import { Divider } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which way the line runs. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Words in the middle of the line, read as text. Horizontal only. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop. |

### Drawer

A side panel that slides in from the edge, for a form or the details of a row, while the list stays in sight. It is a dialog docked to the side: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, only the body scrolls, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/drawer

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer'` | `'default'` | 'drawer': full height on the inline end. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide; the full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | title, description, open, onOpenChange, actions, dismissable and closeLabel work as in the dialog. |

### Empty state

What a list, table or page shows while it has nothing in it. It says what will appear here, why it is empty now, and offers the one action that fills it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/empty-state

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Required. What is missing, as a heading. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title, so it fits the page outline. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | The action that fills the space. One, usually. |

### Fieldset

A titled group of fields inside a longer form. Screen readers read the legend as they enter the group, so a field called Street is heard as part of the delivery address.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/fieldset

```tsx
import { Fieldset } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legend` | `string` |  | Required. The group title. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | A line under the legend, read with the group. |
| `...props` | `fieldset props` |  | Every native fieldset prop, such as disabled. |

### File field

The browser's own file input, with a label, hint and error, in a zone that also takes files dropped on it. The native button and file names stay, so it works with the keyboard, screen readers and phone cameras as usual.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/file-field

```tsx
import { FileField } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// onFiles gets a File[] for a pick or a drop. Every other prop goes to the input.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label. |
| `onFiles` | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Called after a pick or a drop. |
| `hint, error, dropText` | `string` |  | As in Angular. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: accept, multiple, name, onChange, ref. |

### Language switcher

Switches the interface language. Each language is named in itself, so someone who reads only that language can find it, and carries its lang, so screen readers say it in the right voice. No flags: a flag is a country, not a language. Set lang and dir on the html element when the language changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/language-switcher

```tsx
import { LanguageSwitcher, type Language } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `languages` | `Language[]` |  | Required. { code, name }, each name in its own language. |
| `current` | `string` |  | Required. The current language's code. |
| `onChange` | `(code: string) => void` |  | Required. Called with the chosen language's code. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Language'` | Three or more: read before the current name on the button. Translate it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | The button's size. |

### Menu

A short list of actions that opens from a button, such as the actions on a row. Enter, Space or the down arrow open it, the arrow keys and typing move through it, and Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button. For choosing a value, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/menu

```tsx
import { Menu } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Required. The button's content. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | The button's name, when its content is an icon. |
| `items` | `MenuAction[]` |  | Required. { id, label, danger?, disabled? }. |
| `onAction` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Required. Called with the chosen action's id. |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `'secondary'` | The button's look. |

### Navigation

The app's main links, in a side bar. A named navigation landmark, links at least 44px tall, and the current page marked with a bar and bold text, not only a fill. On a phone, put the same links in a drawer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/nav

```tsx
import { Nav } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the landmark. |
| `...props` | `nav props` |  | Every native nav prop. |

### Pagination

Moves through long lists a page at a time. A named navigation landmark: each page button says its number, the current page is marked, and the line of shown rows is announced when it changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/pagination

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page / onPageChange` | `number / (page) => void` |  | Required. The current page, from 1. |
| `total` | `number` |  | Required. Rows across all pages. |
| `pageSize / onPageSizeChange` | `number / (size) => void` | `10` | Rows per page; a new size also calls onPageChange(1). |
| `pageSizes` | `number[]` | `[]` | Offer these sizes in a picker. Empty: no picker. |
| `labels` | `Partial<PaginationLabels>` |  | Translated texts: nav, previous, next, page(n), summary(first, last, total), pageSize. |

### Popover

A small panel next to its button, for a few details or a couple of settings. It is not modal: focus moves into it, and Escape or a click outside closes it and puts focus back on the button. Screen readers name it after the button. For a task that needs the reader's full attention, use a dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/popover

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement` |  | Required. One pressable element, such as Button. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The content of the panel. |
| `placement` | `'bottom start' \| 'top start' \| …` | `'bottom start'` | Where it opens, if there is room. |

### Progress

How far a long task has got, such as an upload. The native progress bar, named by its label, with the amount in words beside it. Without a value it shows a moving band: work is going on but its length is not known.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/progress

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the bar. |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | How much is done. Leave it out when unknown. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | The value when done. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | The amount in words; defaults to a percentage. |

### Radio group

One choice from a short list, with every option in view. Native radios: Tab reaches the group, arrow keys move the choice. For more than five or six options, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/radio-group

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the group. |
| `options` | `RadioOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? }; values are strings. |
| `value, defaultValue` | `T` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the new choice. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Side by side for two or three short answers. |
| `hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables every radio. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; made up when left out. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid prefix; each radio gets -<index>. |

### Rating

Stars out of five, to pick a score or to show one. Picking uses real radio buttons, so Tab reaches the stars, arrow keys move between them and a screen reader says 3 stars, 3 of 5. Filled stars are solid and empty ones an outline, so the shape tells them apart, not only colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/rating

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

### Select

One choice from a list. Arrow keys, Home and End, and typing the first letters all move through the options; Escape and Tab close the list and return focus.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/select

```tsx
import { Select, type SelectOption } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label; it names the button and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? } for each option; value is a string or number. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `T \| null` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the value of the picked option. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the field invalid and announces the message. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the select. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Field name, so the value is sent with a native form. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the button; options get -option-<index>. |

### Skeleton

Grey shapes where content is loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Screen readers skip the shapes: mark the area busy and say it is loading with a spinner or a status message. With reduced motion the shapes stop pulsing.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/skeleton

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'circle' \| 'block'` | `'text'` | Lines, an avatar, or an image or card. |
| `lines` | `number` | `1` | Lines of text; the last one is shorter. |

### Slider

A value picked along a range, such as a price limit or a volume. It is the browser's own range input, so arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End all move it, and the value is written beside the label. For an exact number, use a number field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/slider

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: step, name, disabled, ref.
```

### Spinner

Shows that something is loading and says what, in words, to screen readers. Keep it for waits of more than a second. With reduced motion it stops turning and stays as a faint ring.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/spinner

```tsx
import { Spinner } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading'` | What is loading, translated. |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label next to it too. |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | lg: a big spinner over its label. |

### Stat

One number with its label, and how it changed. The change is written out, with its sign or in words; the arrow and the colour only repeat it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stat

```tsx
import { Stat } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

### Stepper

A flow split into steps, such as checkout. Each step holds its own content, and the stepper shows the current one with Back and Next under it. The step names are buttons, so people can go back. Done steps have a tick and are read as Done, the current one is announced as the current step, and focus moves to the new step's content after each change.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stepper

```tsx
import { Stepper } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

### Switch

An on or off setting that takes effect at once, with no save button. Screen readers say on and off, and the knob's side shows the state, so it never depends on colour. For a choice saved with a form, use a checkbox.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/switch

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: checked, onChange, name, ref.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The setting it turns on. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under it, read with the switch. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: checked, defaultChecked, onChange, disabled, ref. |

### Tabs

Views of one thing side by side, such as an order's details and its history. Tab reaches the chosen tab, the arrow keys move between tabs and show each one, Home and End go to the first and last. The chosen tab gets a bar and full-strength text, not only a colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tabs

```tsx
import { TabNav, Tabs } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Arrow keys follow the locale's direction: wrap Arabic pages in <I18nProvider locale="ar">.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the tab list. |
| `tabs` | `TabItem[]` |  | Required. { id, label, content, disabled?, keep? }. content mounts only while its tab is chosen; keep holds it once shown. |
| `selected, defaultSelected` | `string` |  | The chosen tab's id, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called when another tab is chosen. |
| `TabNav label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the navigation; put links with className="ui-tab" inside, the current one aria-current="page". |

### Tag

A label the user added or can take away, such as an active filter or a topic. For a status like Paid or Late, use a badge.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tag

```tsx
import { Tag } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  | Shows the × button and is called when it is pressed. Remove the tag and move focus on. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | `'Remove'` | The button's first word; the tag's text follows it. Translate it. |
| `...props` | `span props` |  | Every native span prop. |

### Text field

Label, input, hint and error as one control. The label, hint and error are tied to the input, so screen readers read all three.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/text-field

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: value, onChange, name, ref,
// so it works with React Hook Form's register() too.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the input. |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'search' \| 'tel' \| 'url'` | `'text'` | The input type. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the input, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the input invalid and announces the message. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: value, defaultValue, onChange, name, autoComplete, disabled, ref. |

### Textarea

The multi-line twin of the text field: the same label, hint and error, with room for a few lines. The reader can make it taller.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/textarea

```tsx
import { Textarea } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the textarea: value, onChange, rows, maxLength, ref.
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the textarea. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the textarea, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the textarea invalid and announces the message. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the textarea, for tests. |
| `...props` | `textarea props` | `rows: 3` | Every native textarea prop: value, onChange, rows, maxLength, name, ref. |

### Toast

A short note after an action, such as Saved, at the bottom end of the screen. Screen readers hear it as it comes. It closes by itself after 6 seconds, but never while the pointer or focus is on it, and never when it holds an action, so nobody loses the Undo to a timer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/toast

```tsx
import { ToastProvider, useToast } from '@enigma-ui/react';

// Once, around the app:
<ToastProvider label="Notifications" closeLabel="Dismiss">{app}</ToastProvider>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<ToastProvider>` | `component` |  | Once around the app. Takes label and closeLabel. |
| `useToast().show(message, options?)` | `number` |  | As in Angular. |
| `useToast().dismiss(id)` | `void` |  | Closes a toast. |

### Tooltip

A short label for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus and read by screen readers as its description. The pointer can move onto it and Escape hides it. Touch screens never show tooltips, so never put anything needed in one.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tooltip

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from '@enigma-ui/react';
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` |  | Required. The short label. |
| `children` | `ReactElement` |  | One focusable element, such as Button. |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | `'top'` | Where it shows, if there is room. |

### Tree

Nested items that open and close, such as folders or menu categories. One Tab stop: the arrow keys move, Right opens a branch and Left closes it, typing a name jumps to it, and Enter or Space selects. For a site's page links, use navigation instead.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tree

```tsx
import { Tree, type TreeNode } from '@enigma-ui/react';
// On the React Aria tree.
```


# Plain HTML and CSS

## Setup (Plain HTML and CSS)

```sh
pnpm add @enigma-ui/css
pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
```

```css
/* src/app.css */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@enigma-ui/css/tailwind.css';
```

```sh
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/app.css -o dist/app.css --watch
```

Without Tailwind, load `@enigma-ui/css/ui.css` alone and use the `ui-` classes (`ui-p-4`, `ui-head-md`). The package ships no JavaScript: behaviour is yours to write, each page lists the elements and attributes it needs. Keep the `fonts` folder next to the CSS.

## Components (Plain HTML and CSS)

### Accordion

A stack of sections that open and close, such as questions and answers. Built on the native details element, so it opens with Enter and Space, works without script, and the browser's find-in-page opens the section that holds the match. Sections grow and shrink smoothly both ways, Up and Down move between the headings, and the chevron mirrors in Arabic.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/accordion

```html
<div class="ui-accordion">
  <details class="ui-accordion__item" name="faq">
    <summary><span class="ui-accordion__heading">Can I change my order?</span></summary>
    <div class="ui-accordion__content"><p>Yes, until it ships.</p></div>
  </details>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-accordion` | `class` |  | The wrapper. |
| `ui-accordion--icon-start` | `class` |  | On the wrapper: the chevron before each heading. |
| `ui-accordion__item` | `class` |  | On each details; one name for one at a time. Add --icon-start or --no-icon for one item. |
| `ui-accordion__heading, __description` | `class` |  | Inside the summary: the heading text, and a quieter line. |
| `ui-accordion__content` | `class` |  | Around the content. It grows and shrinks; without script, Safari closes it at once. |

### Alert dialog

A short message that needs an answer before the reader goes on: confirm a delete, keep or discard changes. Only its buttons answer: Escape and a click outside do nothing, because the reader has to choose. Focus starts on the safest button.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert-dialog

```html
<dialog class="ui-dialog ui-dialog--sm ui-dialog--alert" role="alertdialog"
  closedby="none" oncancel="event.preventDefault()"
  aria-labelledby="title" aria-describedby="message">...</dialog>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `role="alertdialog"` | `attribute` |  | On the dialog. Name and describe it with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. |
| `ui-dialog--alert` | `class` |  | Centres the icon, heading and actions. |
| `ui-dialog__icon--info \| --success \| --warning \| --danger` | `class` |  | The tone icon, with aria-hidden="true". |
| `autofocus` | `attribute` |  | On the safest button, so focus starts there. |

### Alert

A message in the page, such as a problem with the whole form or a notice about the account. The title says what it is in words; the icon's shape and the colour repeat it. For a note after an action, use a toast; for a question that needs an answer, an alert dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/alert

```html
<div class="ui-alert ui-alert--success">
  <svg class="ui-alert__icon" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>
  <div class="ui-alert__body">
    <p class="ui-alert__title">Payment received</p>
    <p>Invoice 1042 is paid.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-alert` | `class` |  | On its own it is the info tone. |
| `ui-alert--success \| --warning \| --danger` | `class` |  | The tone. |
| `ui-alert__icon, __body, __title, __actions, __close` | `class` |  | The parts. Hide the icon from screen readers. |

### Avatar

A person's photo, or their initials when there is no photo or it fails to load. Screen readers hear the person's name, never the file name.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/avatar

```html
<span class="ui-avatar" role="img" aria-label="Mona Adel">MA</span>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-avatar` | `class` |  | Required. Add role="img" and aria-label with the name, or aria-hidden="true" when the name is beside it. |
| `ui-avatar--sm \| --lg` | `class` |  | The size. Without one it is 40 pixels. |
