| `--ui-avatar-size` | `custom property` | `2.5rem` | Any other size; the initials scale with it. |
| `img alt=""` | `child` |  | The photo. Its alt stays empty: the avatar itself carries the name. Swap to initials on its error event. |

### Badge

A short status label, such as the state of an order. The words carry the meaning and the colour only repeats it, so every status reads the same without colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/badge

```html
<span class="ui-badge ui-badge--success">Paid</span>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-badge` | `class` |  | Required. On its own it is the neutral badge. |
| `ui-badge--info \| --success \| --warning \| --danger` | `class` |  | The colour. Use one at most. |

### Bottom sheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen, for a short choice or the details of an item, mostly on phones. It is a dialog docked to the bottom: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click above it closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/bottom-sheet

```html
<dialog class="ui-dialog ui-dialog--sheet" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="title">...</dialog>
<!-- open it with dialog.showModal(), never show() -->
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dialog.ui-dialog.ui-dialog--sheet` | `element + class` |  | Open it with showModal(), never show(), so focus is trapped and the page is inert. |
| `ui-dialog--sm \| --lg` | `class` |  | Its width on a wide screen: 24 or 48rem; 32rem without it. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | The same markup and classes as the dialog. |

### Breadcrumbs

Where the page sits, as a trail of links back up. A named navigation landmark around an ordered list; the last item is the page itself, marked as current and not a link. The slashes are drawn, not read out.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/breadcrumbs

```html
<nav class="ui-breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <ol>
    <li><a href="/orders">Orders</a></li>
    <li><span aria-current="page">Order 1042</span></li>
  </ol>
</nav>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-breadcrumbs` | `class` |  | On a nav with aria-label, around an ol. |
| `aria-current="page"` | `attribute` |  | On the last item, which is not a link. |

### Button

Styles the native button, so it keeps everything the browser gives a button: focus, Enter and Space, form submit. Four variants and three sizes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/button

```html
<button class="ui-button ui-button--primary ui-button--md">Save</button>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-button` | `class` |  | Required on every button. |
| `ui-button--primary \| --secondary \| --ghost \| --danger` | `class` |  | The variant. Use exactly one. |
| `ui-button--sm \| --md \| --lg` | `class` |  | The size. Use exactly one. |
| `aria-busy="true" + disabled` | `attribute` |  | Loading state; add a span.ui-spinner with aria-hidden="true" before the label. |

### Calendar

A month grid to pick a day or a range, such as a delivery day or a stay. One Tab stop: arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End go to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down change the month, with Shift the year. Each day is read in full, Thursday, 19 November 2026. Today is underlined and picked days are filled, so neither depends on colour. Use it when seeing the month helps: open and closed days, a range, or the weekday. For a date people already know, such as a birthday, use the date field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/calendar

```html
<!-- The classes only. The keyboard, roving Tab stop and day names need script:
     use the Angular or React package, or copy the markup they render. -->
<div class="ui-calendar" role="group" aria-label="Delivery day">…</div>
```

### Card

A surface that groups related content: a summary, a list, a form. Cards are flat, with a thin border; shadows are kept for things that float, like menus and dialogs.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/card

```html
<div class="ui-card">...</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-card` | `class` |  | Required. Stacks its children with a 1rem gap. |
| `ui-card--lg` | `class` |  | More padding. |
| `ui-card__title` | `class` |  | On the heading (h2 to h4, to fit the page). |

### Checkbox

A yes or no that is saved with the form, such as accepting the terms. The native checkbox in the primary colour; the whole label is the hit area, at least 44px tall.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/checkbox

```html
<label class="ui-check">
  <input type="checkbox" name="updates" />
  Email me about my orders
</label>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-check` | `class` |  | On the label that wraps the input and its text. |
| `ui-field, ui-field--invalid` | `class` |  | A wrapper when there is a hint or an error; list their ids in aria-describedby. |

### Chip input

A text field that collects several short values, such as toppings, email addresses or skills. Each value becomes a tag with its own named remove button. Screen readers hear each value being added and removed, and focus never falls off the field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/chip-input

```html
<div class="ui-chips">...</div>
<!-- Adding, removing, focus and announcements need script: use the Angular or React component. -->
```

### Combobox

A text field that filters a list as you type, for a long list such as countries. Focus stays in the field: arrow keys move through the matches, Enter picks one and Escape closes the list. The value is always one of the options.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/combobox

```html
<!-- A combobox needs script for the keyboard and the list. Use a framework package,
     or follow the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with these classes: -->
<input class="ui-input" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="list" />
<ul class="ui-listbox" role="listbox" id="list">
  <li class="ui-option ui-option--active" role="option" aria-selected="false">Egypt</li>
</ul>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-input + role="combobox"` | `element` |  | The field, with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant. |
| `ui-listbox, ui-option, ui-option--active` | `class` |  | The list, as for the select. |
| `ui-listbox__empty` | `class` |  | The "no matches" line, with role="status". |

### Command palette

A search over the app's actions, in a dialog. Ctrl+K or ⌘K opens it from anywhere; typing filters, the arrow keys move and Enter runs. Screen readers hear how many commands match as you type. Keep a visible button for it too: a shortcut nobody knows about is no way in.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/command-palette

```html
<!-- Filtering, keys and focus need script: use the Angular or React component.
     The classes are ui-command, ui-command__list, ui-option and ui-command__shortcut. -->
```

### Data table

Rows of records the reader scans and compares: orders, users, payments. A real table, named by its caption, so screen readers announce the row and column of every cell. Sorting is announced too.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/data-table

```html
<div class="ui-table-wrap">
  <table class="ui-table">
    <caption class="ui-table__caption">Orders</caption>
    ...
  </table>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-table-wrap` | `class` |  | Scrolls sideways on narrow screens. If it can scroll, add tabindex="0", role="region" and aria-labelledby the caption. |
| `table.ui-table + caption.ui-table__caption` | `element + class` |  | The table and its name. Add ui-visually-hidden to the caption to hide it visually. |
| `th scope="col"` | `attribute` |  | On every header cell. |
| `aria-sort + button.ui-table__sort` | `attribute + class` |  | On sortable headers: ascending, descending or none. |
| `ui-table__cell--end \| --center` | `class` |  | Alignment, on the th and every td of the column. |
| `ui-table__empty, ui-table__loading` | `class` |  | The empty row, and the loading overlay with a status message. |

### Date and number fields

The text field with the browser's own date, time and number inputs. The picker comes in the reader's language and calendar, works with the keyboard and screen readers, and opens the right keypad on a phone. The value stays a plain ISO date, such as 2026-12-01.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/date-field

```html
<input class="ui-input" type="date" id="move-in" />
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input.ui-input` | `element + class` |  | With type="date", "time", "datetime-local" or "number", inside a ui-field. |

### Dialog

A modal window for a task that needs the reader's full attention: a short form, details, terms. Focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/dialog

```html
<dialog class="ui-dialog" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="title">...</dialog>
<!-- open it with dialog.showModal(), never show() -->
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dialog.ui-dialog` | `element + class` |  | Open it with showModal(), never show(), so focus is trapped and the page is inert. |
| `ui-dialog--sm \| --lg` | `class` |  | 24 or 48rem wide; 32rem without it. |
| `closedby="any"` | `attribute` |  | A click outside closes it too, in browsers that support it; Escape always does. closedby="none" plus oncancel="event.preventDefault()": only your buttons close it. |
| `aria-labelledby / aria-describedby` | `attribute` |  | Point at the title and the description ids. |
| `ui-dialog__header, __heading, __title, __description` | `class` |  | The heading area. |
| `ui-dialog__body` | `class` |  | The content; it scrolls when it is long. |
| `form[method="dialog"] + ui-dialog__actions` | `element + class` |  | Buttons inside close the dialog and set returnValue to their value. |

### Divider

A thin line between groups of content. Reach for space first: a divider is for when space alone does not show where one group ends.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/divider

```html
<hr class="ui-divider" />
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-divider` | `class` |  | Required. On an hr it is a separator already; on a div add role="separator". |
| `ui-divider--vertical` | `class` |  | Vertical. Add aria-orientation="vertical". |
| `ui-divider--label` | `class` |  | Words in the middle. No separator role, so the words are read. |

### Drawer

A side panel that slides in from the edge, for a form or the details of a row, while the list stays in sight. It is a dialog docked to the side: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, only the body scrolls, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/drawer

```html
<dialog class="ui-dialog ui-dialog--drawer" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="title">...</dialog>
<!-- open it with dialog.showModal(), never show() -->
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dialog.ui-dialog.ui-dialog--drawer` | `element + class` |  | Open it with showModal(), never show(), so focus is trapped and the page is inert. |
| `ui-dialog--sm \| --lg` | `class` |  | 24 or 48rem wide; 32rem without it. |
| `everything else` | `` |  | The same markup and classes as the dialog. |

### Empty state

What a list, table or page shows while it has nothing in it. It says what will appear here, why it is empty now, and offers the one action that fills it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/empty-state

```html
<div class="ui-empty-state">...</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-empty-state` | `class` |  | Required. Centres its content. |
| `ui-empty-state__title` | `class` |  | On the heading. |
| `ui-empty-state__actions` | `class` |  | Around the buttons. |

### Fieldset

A titled group of fields inside a longer form. Screen readers read the legend as they enter the group, so a field called Street is heard as part of the delivery address.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/fieldset

```html
<fieldset class="ui-fieldset">
  <legend class="ui-fieldset__legend">Delivery address</legend>
  …fields
</fieldset>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-fieldset` | `class` |  | On the fieldset; spaces the fields in it. |
| `ui-fieldset__legend` | `class` |  | On its legend. |

### File field

The browser's own file input, with a label, hint and error, in a zone that also takes files dropped on it. The native button and file names stay, so it works with the keyboard, screen readers and phone cameras as usual.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/file-field

```html
<input class="ui-file" type="file" id="invoice" accept=".pdf" />
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-file` | `class` |  | On the input type="file". |
| `ui-dropzone` | `class` |  | The dashed zone around it. |
| `ui-dropzone--over` | `class` |  | While a file is dragged over the zone. |
| `ui-dropzone__text` | `class` |  | The line under the button. |

### Language switcher

Switches the interface language. Each language is named in itself, so someone who reads only that language can find it, and carries its lang, so screen readers say it in the right voice. No flags: a flag is a country, not a language. Set lang and dir on the html element when the language changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/language-switcher

```html
<!-- Two languages: a link to the other one, named in itself -->
<a class="ui-button ui-button--secondary ui-button--md" href="/ar/" lang="ar" hreflang="ar">عربي</a>
<!-- Three or more: the menu button pattern, see Menu, with role="menuitemradio" and aria-checked -->
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lang` | `attribute` |  | On each language name, with its own code. |
| `ui-menu__item[aria-checked="true"]` | `selector` |  | The current language in a menu: bold, with a check mark. |

### Menu

A short list of actions that opens from a button, such as the actions on a row. Enter, Space or the down arrow open it, the arrow keys and typing move through it, and Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button. For choosing a value, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/menu

```html
<!-- A menu needs script for the keyboard. Follow the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern with these classes: -->
<button class="ui-button ui-button--secondary" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="true">Actions</button>
<div class="ui-menu" role="menu">
  <button class="ui-menu__item" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">Edit</button>
  <button class="ui-menu__item ui-menu__item--danger" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">Delete</button>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-menu` | `class` |  | On the element with role="menu". |
| `ui-menu__item` | `class` |  | On each role="menuitem". |
| `ui-menu__item--danger` | `class` |  | Red text, for a destructive action. |
| `ui-menu__separator` | `class` |  | A line between groups, with role="separator". |

### Navigation

The app's main links, in a side bar. A named navigation landmark, links at least 44px tall, and the current page marked with a bar and bold text, not only a fill. On a phone, put the same links in a drawer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/nav

```html
<nav class="ui-nav" aria-label="Main">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/orders" aria-current="page">Orders</a></li>
    <li><a href="/invoices">Invoices</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-nav` | `class` |  | On a nav with aria-label. |
| `ui-nav__title` | `class` |  | A group title; add ui-label for the mono caps. |
| `aria-current="page"` | `attribute` |  | On the current page's link. |

### Pagination

Moves through long lists a page at a time. A named navigation landmark: each page button says its number, the current page is marked, and the line of shown rows is announced when it changes.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/pagination

```html
<nav class="ui-pagination" aria-label="Pagination">...</nav>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nav.ui-pagination + aria-label` | `element + class` |  | A named navigation landmark. |
| `ui-pagination__summary role="status"` | `class + attribute` |  | Which rows are shown, announced when it changes. |
| `ui-pagination__page + aria-label + aria-current` | `class + attribute` |  | Name every page button, and mark the current one with aria-current="page". |
| `ui-pagination__step + aria-disabled` | `class + attribute` |  | Previous and next; at the ends use aria-disabled="true", not disabled. |
| `ui-pagination__gap aria-hidden` | `class + attribute` |  | The "…" between page numbers. |

### Popover

A small panel next to its button, for a few details or a couple of settings. It is not modal: focus moves into it, and Escape or a click outside closes it and puts focus back on the button. Screen readers name it after the button. For a task that needs the reader's full attention, use a dialog.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/popover

```html
<!-- The native popover attribute opens it with no script; place it yourself. -->
<button class="ui-button ui-button--secondary" popovertarget="fee" id="fee-button">Delivery fee</button>
<div class="ui-popover" id="fee" popover role="dialog" aria-labelledby="fee-button">
  <p>Free on orders over EGP 500.</p>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-popover` | `class` |  | On the panel, with role="dialog" named by its button. |
| `ui-popover__title` | `class` |  | A bold first line. |

### Progress

How far a long task has got, such as an upload. The native progress bar, named by its label, with the amount in words beside it. Without a value it shows a moving band: work is going on but its length is not known.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/progress

```html
<div class="ui-progress">
  <div class="ui-progress__head">
    <span class="ui-progress__label" id="upload">Uploading invoice.pdf</span>
    <span class="ui-progress__value" aria-hidden="true">64%</span>
  </div>
  <progress class="ui-progress__bar" aria-labelledby="upload" value="64" max="100"></progress>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-progress` | `class` |  | The wrapper: label, amount, bar. |
| `ui-progress__bar` | `class` |  | On the progress element, named with aria-labelledby. |
| `ui-progress__label, __value` | `class` |  | The words above it; hide the amount from screen readers. |

### Radio group

One choice from a short list, with every option in view. Native radios: Tab reaches the group, arrow keys move the choice. For more than five or six options, use a select.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/radio-group

```html
<div class="ui-field" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="speed-label">
  <span class="ui-field__label" id="speed-label">Delivery</span>
  <div class="ui-choices">
    <label class="ui-check"><input type="radio" name="speed" value="std" /> Standard</label>
    <label class="ui-check"><input type="radio" name="speed" value="exp" /> Express</label>
  </div>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `role="radiogroup"` | `attribute` |  | On the ui-field wrapper, with aria-labelledby pointing at the label. |
| `ui-choices` | `class` |  | Holds the radios, one per line. |
| `ui-choices--inline` | `class` |  | Puts them side by side. |
| `ui-check` | `class` |  | On each label that wraps a radio. Give every radio the same name. |

### Rating

Stars out of five, to pick a score or to show one. Picking uses real radio buttons, so Tab reaches the stars, arrow keys move between them and a screen reader says 3 stars, 3 of 5. Filled stars are solid and empty ones an outline, so the shape tells them apart, not only colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/rating

```html
<fieldset class="ui-rating">...</fieldset>
```

### Select

One choice from a list. Arrow keys, Home and End, and typing the first letters all move through the options; Escape and Tab close the list and return focus.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/select

```html
<select class="ui-input" id="city">...</select>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select.ui-input` | `element + class` |  | A native select inside a ui-field, with a label as for the text field. |
| `aria-invalid="true"` | `attribute` |  | With a ui-field__error message listed in aria-describedby. |

### Skeleton

Grey shapes where content is loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Screen readers skip the shapes: mark the area busy and say it is loading with a spinner or a status message. With reduced motion the shapes stop pulsing.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/skeleton

```html
<div class="ui-skeleton ui-skeleton--text" aria-hidden="true">
  <span class="ui-skeleton__shape"></span>
  <span class="ui-skeleton__shape"></span>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-skeleton` | `class` |  | The wrapper, with aria-hidden="true". |
| `ui-skeleton--text \| --circle \| --block` | `class` |  | The shape. |
| `ui-skeleton__shape` | `class` |  | One grey shape; one per line of text. |

### Slider

A value picked along a range, such as a price limit or a volume. It is the browser's own range input, so arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End all move it, and the value is written beside the label. For an exact number, use a number field.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/slider

```html
<input type="range" class="ui-slider" />
```

### Spinner

Shows that something is loading and says what, in words, to screen readers. Keep it for waits of more than a second. With reduced motion it stops turning and stays as a faint ring.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/spinner

```html
<span class="ui-loading" role="status">
  <span class="ui-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <span class="ui-visually-hidden">Loading orders</span>
</span>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-loading` | `class` |  | The spinner and its words, with role="status". |
| `ui-loading--lg` | `class` |  | The big one, over its label. |
| `ui-spinner` | `class` |  | The ring; hide it from screen readers. |

### Stat

One number with its label, and how it changed. The change is written out, with its sign or in words; the arrow and the colour only repeat it.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stat

```html
<div class="ui-stat">...</div>
```

### Stepper

A flow split into steps, such as checkout. Each step holds its own content, and the stepper shows the current one with Back and Next under it. The step names are buttons, so people can go back. Done steps have a tick and are read as Done, the current one is announced as the current step, and focus moves to the new step's content after each change.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/stepper

```html
<div class="ui-stepper">
  <ol class="ui-steps" aria-label="Checkout">...</ol>
  <section class="ui-stepper__panel">...</section>
  <div class="ui-stepper__actions">...</div>
</div>
```

### Switch

An on or off setting that takes effect at once, with no save button. Screen readers say on and off, and the knob's side shows the state, so it never depends on colour. For a choice saved with a form, use a checkbox.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/switch

```html
<label class="ui-switch">
  Order updates
  <input type="checkbox" role="switch" class="ui-switch__input" />
</label>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-switch` | `class` |  | On the label: the text, then the input. |
| `ui-switch__input` | `class` |  | On an input type="checkbox" with role="switch". |

### Tabs

Views of one thing side by side, such as an order's details and its history. Tab reaches the chosen tab, the arrow keys move between tabs and show each one, Home and End go to the first and last. The chosen tab gets a bar and full-strength text, not only a colour.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tabs

```html
<!-- Tabs need script for the keyboard. Follow the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with these classes: -->
<div class="ui-tabs">
  <div class="ui-tabs__list" role="tablist" aria-label="Order 1042">
    <button class="ui-tab" role="tab" id="t1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="p1">Details</button>
    <button class="ui-tab" role="tab" id="t2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="p2" tabindex="-1">History</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ui-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="p1" aria-labelledby="t1" tabindex="0">…</div>
  <div class="ui-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="p2" aria-labelledby="t2" tabindex="0" hidden>…</div>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-tabs` | `class` |  | The wrapper. |
| `ui-tabs__list` | `class` |  | On the element with role="tablist", or on a <nav> of links. Scrolls when the tabs are wider. |
| `ui-tabs__bar, ui-tabs__scroll` | `class` |  | A row holding the list and an arrow button at each end; give the arrows tabindex="-1" and aria-hidden="true". |
| `ui-tab` | `class` |  | On each button with role="tab" (aria-selected marks the chosen one), or each link (aria-current="page"). |
| `ui-tabs__panel` | `class` |  | On each element with role="tabpanel". |

### Tag

A label the user added or can take away, such as an active filter or a topic. For a status like Paid or Late, use a badge.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tag

```html
<span class="ui-tag">Angular</span>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-tag` | `class` |  | Required. |
| `ui-tag__remove` | `class` |  | The × button, 24 pixels square. Label it with aria-labelledby: its own aria-label, then the text. |

### Text field

Label, input, hint and error as one control. The label, hint and error are tied to the input, so screen readers read all three.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/text-field

```html
<div class="ui-field">
  <label class="ui-field__label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input class="ui-input" id="email" type="email" />
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-field` | `class` |  | The wrapper: stacks label, input, hint and error. |
| `ui-field__label` | `class` |  | On the label; its for matches the input id. |
| `ui-input` | `class` |  | On the input (also works on a native select). |
| `ui-field__hint` | `class` |  | Help text; list its id in the input aria-describedby. |
| `ui-field__error` | `class` |  | The error, with role="alert"; set aria-invalid="true" on the input and list the error id in aria-describedby. |

### Textarea

The multi-line twin of the text field: the same label, hint and error, with room for a few lines. The reader can make it taller.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/textarea

```html
<div class="ui-field">
  <label class="ui-field__label" for="notes">Delivery notes</label>
  <textarea class="ui-input" id="notes" rows="4"></textarea>
</div>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textarea.ui-input` | `element + class` |  | Inside a ui-field, with a label as for the text field. |
| `ui-field__hint, ui-field__error` | `class` |  | As for the text field: list their ids in aria-describedby; set aria-invalid="true" with an error. |

### Toast

A short note after an action, such as Saved, at the bottom end of the screen. Screen readers hear it as it comes. It closes by itself after 6 seconds, but never while the pointer or focus is on it, and never when it holds an action, so nobody loses the Undo to a timer.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/toast

```html
<!-- Toasts need script to come and go. The markup they use: -->
<section aria-label="Notifications">
  <ol class="ui-toast-region">
    <li class="ui-alert ui-alert--success ui-toast">…as an alert</li>
  </ol>
</section>
<!-- Announce each one through a live region that is already on the page. -->
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-toast-region` | `class` |  | The list at the bottom end of the screen. |
| `ui-toast` | `class` |  | On each ui-alert in it: shadow and entry motion. |

### Tooltip

A short label for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus and read by screen readers as its description. The pointer can move onto it and Escape hides it. Touch screens never show tooltips, so never put anything needed in one.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tooltip

```html
<!-- A tooltip needs script to show and hide. The markup it uses: -->
<button class="ui-button ui-button--ghost" aria-label="Copy link" aria-describedby="tip">…</button>
<span class="ui-tooltip" role="tooltip" id="tip">Copy link</span>
```

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-tooltip` | `class` |  | On the element with role="tooltip". |
| `aria-describedby` | `attribute` |  | On the control, pointing at the tooltip's id. |

### Tree

Nested items that open and close, such as folders or menu categories. One Tab stop: the arrow keys move, Right opens a branch and Left closes it, typing a name jumps to it, and Enter or Space selects. For a site's page links, use navigation instead.

Docs: https://enigma-tech-labs.github.io/enigma-ui/components/tree

```html
<!-- Keys, focus and opening need script: use the Angular or React component.
     The classes are ui-tree, ui-tree__item, ui-tree__chevron and --ui-tree-level. -->
```
